title: Settings
sidebarModulesDesc: Choose which feature entries appear in the sidebar
harnessWorkspaceHint: The directory the Harness reads/writes projects from. You can move it to another drive to save space on C:. Changes take effect after restarting the Harness.
harnessWorkspaceSaved: Workspace updated. Restart the Harness to apply.
modelSupportsVisionHint: Enable if this model can accept images; otherwise the Harness reports "does not support image input" when reading/sending images
autoCleanHistoryHint: Cleans inactive sessions older than the selected age at startup, at most once per day
aboutDesc: A desktop app integrating notes, knowledge base, and AI assistant to help you manage knowledge and spark inspiration.
featureSmartNoteDesc: Supports Markdown editing, live preview, and AI content completion for efficient note-taking.
featureRagDesc: Vectorize personal and local knowledge base documents for fast semantic retrieval.
featureAiAssistantDesc: Invoke Phronesis anytime (⌘ + Space) for Q&A, creation, and analysis with your knowledge base.
featureMultiModelDesc: Custom integrations with Doubao, Qwen, Zhipu, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, and more.
featureBackupDesc: Manual and automatic backups with one-click restore to keep your data safe.
featureAgentDesc: Built-in agent tools to read knowledge base documents and run Python scripts for complex tasks.
restoreConfirm: Restoring will overwrite all current data. Continue?
restoreSuccess: Restore successful. The app will reload to load the restored data.
pythonDetectFail: No Python detected. Please install Python or select the path manually.
pythonInvalidVersion: The selected file is not a valid Python 3 executable. Use this path anyway?
pythonDetectOkDepsOk: Python detected and auto-configured. All dependencies are present.
pythonDetectOkDepsMissing: Python detected and auto-configured, but some dependencies are missing
pythonDetectOkDepsFail: Python detected and auto-configured, but dependency verification failed
runtimeLogsSaveFailed: Failed to save runtime log settings

balance.notSupported: This provider does not support balance query

bridgeHint: Expose the Friday agent as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint so platforms like WeChat ClawBot and QQ (LangBot) can use it as their model backend.
bridgeApiKeyHint: Leave empty to skip auth; when set, platforms must send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` in the header.
bridgeUnattendedHint: When on, tool approvals are skipped and dangerous tools run automatically — enable with caution.
bridgeAllowedOriginsHint: Use "*" to allow all, or a comma-separated list of origins.
bridgeGuideLangbot: QQ (LangBot): choose "OpenAI-compatible" as the model backend, set Base URL to {url} (keep the /v1 suffix), and the model name to your configured model.
bridgeGuideWechat: WeChat ClawBot: in the OpenClaw gateway set the model provider to OpenAI-compatible and point its Base URL at the same address.
bridgeSaved: Bridge config saved and service restarted
directHint: Log into WeChat / QQ right inside Friday so friends and group messages are auto-replied by the Friday agent — no external gateway needed.
directWechatHint: Connects to your logged-in Windows WeChat client via WeChatFerry. Local use, no QR scan required.
directQQHint: Log into QQ via icqq; after scanning the QR code, friend and group messages are auto-replied by Friday.
directQQScan: Scan the QR code above with your phone QQ to log in
directQQScanHint: QR code requested; please scan with your phone QQ
napcatHint: icqq built-in login is rejected by the 2026 QQ protocol, so use the independently maintained NapCat gateway (OneBot v11). Run NapCat on this machine and scan the QR with your phone QQ, then fill in its WebSocket URL and access token — Friday will send/receive QQ messages.
napcatUrlHint: The OneBot v11 WebSocket URL exposed by NapCat, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:3001/onebot/v11/ws
napcatTokenHint: The access_token configured in NapCat; leave empty if none
napcatConnected: NapCat connected; QQ messages will be handled by Friday
qqbotHint: Uses Tencent's official bot API (compliant, stable, no protocol risk) for channels or group-mention scenarios; does not log into a personal account. Create a bot app on the QQ open platform first, then fill appid / secret / token and verify the gateway & API base from your console.
qqbotApiBaseHint: e.g. https://api.bot.qq.com (official unified domain); used for sending messages, usually leave as-is
qqbotGatewayHint: Leave empty to auto-fetch from /gateway/bot; only set when using a proxy or self-hosted relay
systemToolsHint: System tools like WSL, wmic, sc, reg, schtasks can bypass sandbox restrictions — enable with caution
builtinRuntimeHint: Allow using bundled Node.js, Python and Git Bash tools
toolPythonDesc: General-purpose programming language for scripting, automation and data processing
toolNodejsDesc: JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine, for server-side development
toolGitBashDesc: Provides Git and Bash Shell Unix-like command line environment on Windows
wolHint: Add LAN computers to wake remotely. Mobile manages the same list.
mobileQrLoginHint: Scan the QR code below from your phone to log in automatically.
